title: Pure Atlantean
summary: Pure Atlantean Sea Serpent strategy featuring the 2024-2025 support wave alongside classic Atlantean removal effects. Every core Atlantean triggers its effect when sent to the GY to activate a WATER monster's effect, generating massive hand advantage and disruption while climbing into devastating Rank 7 Xyz and high-Level Synchro bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Neptabyss, the Atlantean Prince is the central 1-card starter: it sends an Atlantean monster from Deck to GY as a cost to add any other Atlantean card to hand, immediately triggering the sent monster's effect.
Poseidra, the Storming Atlantean can Special Summon itself from hand or GY by sending a WATER monster from field to GY, then sends an Atlantean from Deck to GY to bounce an opponent's card.
Atlantean Heavy Infantry grants an additional Normal Summon of a Sea Serpent monster during your Main Phase, helping flood the board.
Abyssrhine, the Atlantean Spirit tributes itself and a WATER monster from hand or field to search a Level 7 Sea Serpent while triggering the tributed WATER monster.

summary.title: Opening: Neptabyss, the Atlantean Prince
steps: Normal Summon Neptabyss, the Atlantean Prince and activate its effect, sending Atlantean Dragoons from your Deck to the GY as cost to add Poseidra, the Storming Atlantean to your hand.

Atlantean Dragoons triggers in the GY since it was sent for a WATER monster's effect, searching another Sea Serpent (such as Mermail Shadow Squad or Abyssrhine, the Atlantean Spirit) from Deck to hand.
Special Summon Poseidra, the Storming Atlantean from your hand by sending Neptabyss to the GY, triggering Neptabyss in GY to revive Atlantean Dragoons.
Activate Poseidra, the Storming Atlantean to send an Atlantean from Deck to GY (such as Atlantean Heavy Infantry to pop a face-up card or another Dragoons) and return an opponent's card to hand.
Utilize Mermail Shadow Squad to modulate Levels to 7 or combine with Poseidra to Xyz Summon Rank 7 bosses like Poseidra Abyss, the Atlantean Dragon Lord or Abysstrite, the Atlantean Spirit.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Poseidra Abyss, the Atlantean Dragon Lord detaches an Xyz Material to bounce up to 3 cards the opponent controls back to the hand, completely breaking opposing setups.
Abysstrite, the Atlantean Spirit detaches a material to Special Summon any Sea Serpent monster from your GY, providing instant recursion for your combo pieces or beatsticks.
Icejade Gymir Aegirine offers Quick Effect protection that prevents your monsters from being destroyed or banished by card effects, and banishes matching cards from the opponent's field or GY.
Adamancipator Risen - Dragite provides a Quick Effect Spell/Trap negation while a WATER monster resides in the GY, alongside non-targeting bounce potential.

Poseidra, the Atlantean Dragon can Tribute 3 Level 3 or lower WATER monsters to summon itself and return all Spells and Traps on the field to the hand, dropping opposing monsters' ATK by 300 for each returned card.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Call of the Atlanteans is a Quick-Play Spell that targets and Special Summons three Level 3 or lower Sea Serpent monsters from your GY at once, facilitating explosive Rank 3 or Link plays or providing tribute fodder on either turn.
Atlantean Heavy Infantry and Atlantean Marksman act as potent removal engines when detached or sent for WATER costs, destroying face-up cards and Set cards respectively.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The wider Mermail family and Deep Sea engines have their own dedicated lists and are left out here to keep the Atlantean Sea Serpents front and center.
